text:
molly.marketing: Quick ask — can runtime re-run the mini-cohort bench (N=50) with the quantized v2 profile and 8k context? We need stable p50/p95/p99 for the launch post and webinar slides. cc @sam.runtime @ari.eng

sam.runtime: Which exact metrics do you need in the artifact? Latency percentiles, cost/token, and coldstart heatmap ok?

molly.marketing: Yep — p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token, coldstart heatmap, and a small set (20) of raw traces for examples. Also want KV-cache hit rate and warmup sample counts per host. Use the same samplepack as the last run but with seed=42 and include the long-tail subset (seq_len>2k). Docs: https://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-protocol (see section "mini-cohort repeatable runs").

ari.eng: We can schedule. Need exact model name + tokenizer + quant flag. Also confirm whether you want prefix/KV cache enabled — that changes coldstart numbers a lot.

molly.marketing: Model: redwood-alpha-8k. Tokenizer: rwd-tokenizer-v3. Quantized variant: q4_2-v2. Please run two branches: quantized-q4_2-v2 and fp16 baseline. Keep prefix/KV cache ON for the main run (that matches production), but also a short run with cache=OFF for coldstart comparison.

leo.metrics: Priority check — is this blocking launch claims or just for internal confidence?

molly.marketing: Blocking for launch materials and press claims. We need a conservative summary. Target deadline: EOD Thursday. If runtime is constrained, a prioritized short run (50 samples / both branches) that yields percentiles and heatmap is acceptable.

sam.runtime: Ok. We'll queue a prioritized mini run tomorrow morning. Deliverables: p50/p95/p99 table, cost/token calc, coldstart heatmap, KV hit rates, and 20 sample traces. We'll attach the run config and raw logs (trimmed). Note: the fp16 baseline will be slower on the quantized path, so expect p95 shifts — we'll include delta column.

sam.runtime: Run command (what we'll use):
```
enqueue-bench --cohort mini50 --seed 42 --model redwood-alpha-8k --tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v3 --variants "q4_2-v2,fp16" --context 8192 --cache on --tags marketing-launch,priority
```

sam.runtime: ETA: start tomorrow 07:30 UTC, estimated wall time 3–4h. If queue spikes, we'll fallback to a 1h prioritized pass and then full run later.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Job queued: #3456 by sam.runtime — status: waiting for runners (link: https://rundashboard/jobs/3456)

sam.runtime: One caveat — warmup counts in our runner default to 5 per host. If you want stricter coldstart numbers, request --warmup 0 and we'll run a dedicated coldstart slice.

molly.marketing: Good call. Please include one quick coldstart slice with --warmup 0 even if it's just 10 samples. That'll be useful for the press heatmap.

sam.runtime: Noted. We'll attach both artifacts to /share/marketing/benchpacks/1720001111-mini50/ and ping here when uploaded.

nina.prod: Logging this run in the launch tracker as milestone "bench-mini50-complete" and linking to job #3456. Thanks team.

molly.marketing: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please tag me when artifacts land so I can start drafting the slide deck and press lines. :pray:
